Hey [Neighbor's Name],

Just wanted to drop you a line about something I noticed today. The little tree that’s been growing outside your garage – it’s getting taller and greener by the day! I saw some new leaves and even a couple of little sprouts. It’s really starting to look like it’s flourishing now that the weather is nicer. 

I thought you might like to know and maybe even take a peek out there to see it for yourself. If you want to chat about it, let me know. It’s always nice to see greenery popping up around our neighborhood.

Hope you're having a great week!
